notes.title: Now Available For FREE
notes.notes:
We are switching Maze And Dagger from paid to free.

Why?
To increase the player base and increase exposure to the Endwise & HatFeather brands (https://endwise.io).

When?
Late September 2018

What happens if I already bought this game?
Nothing. Endwise and HatFeather appreciate your support and hope you've enjoyed your early access to Maze And Dagger.
